The '''Haldeen sector''' was in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], between the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] and the [[Kokash sector/Legends|Kokash sector]]. It bordered the [[Barma sector/Legends|Barma sector]]<ref name="Assault on AX-456">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 1}}</ref>. Planets in the sector included [[Haldeen]], itself, and [[Argai Minor/Legends|Argai Minor]].

==History==
It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gandril]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed [[Argai]] in Haldeen sector. These contradicted all other sources, which placed Argai in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This was corrected by the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which created [[Argai Minor]] and placed it the Haldeen sector.
